territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2) — the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties; Azerbaijan is not a Member State. Azerbaijan levies its own value added tax, Əlavə Dəyər Vergisi (ƏDV), under the Tax Code of the Republic of Azerbaijan, article 161, at a standard rate of 18%, with a zero rate in article 165 and exemptions in article 164, unrelated to the Union's common system.
